name: How do I know if my walls need more insulation?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my walls need more insulation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate your walls might need more insulation. You may feel drafts near outlets or switches, notice uneven temperatures between rooms, or experience excessively high energy bills compared to similar homes. Cold interior walls during winter or heat radiating from walls in summer are also indicators. A professional energy audit can precisely identify areas of heat loss and recommend the most effective insulation solutions for your home's specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include drafts, uneven room temperatures, high energy bills, and cold or hot interior walls. A professional audit can confirm the need.
